name: VWO
description: VWO is an experimentation and digital-experience platform for web and feature tests, rollouts, personalization, analytics, visitor insights, push engagement, campaigns, projects, and environments.
agentUseSummary: Add a customer-owned VWO Enterprise API token with the least available permission level, then let selected agents list up to 100 current-account project IDs and names. Relay pins one project route and blocks environments, campaigns, features, websites, visitors, results, segments, notifications, arbitrary API access, and every mutation.

credentialRequirements.label: VWO API token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a customer-owned Enterprise API token with the least available permission level; Relay encrypts it server-side.

capabilities.label: List projects
capabilities.description: Use only GET /api/v2/accounts/current/projects and return minimized project IDs and names.

allowed.label: List VWO projects
allowed.description: List up to 100 current-account project IDs and names without environments, campaigns, features, visitors, results, or writes.

blocked.label: Change VWO
blocked.description: Project, environment, campaign, feature, website, segment, notification, and every other mutation are blocked.

blocked.label: Read visitor or result data
blocked.description: Visitors, subscribers, segments, campaign results, analytics, insights, settings files, account details, and notification data are blocked.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary API access
blocked.description: Environments, campaigns, features, websites, labels, filters, arbitrary routes, and custom arguments are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: One minimized current-account project-directory read runs directly. Environments, campaigns, features, visitors, results, arbitrary API access, and mutations remain blocked.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts one typed minimized project-directory tool through the encrypted customer-owned VWO API token.
Railway mounts one typed minimized project-directory tool through the encrypted customer-owned VWO API token.

providerSetup.blocker: No customer VWO Enterprise account, least-privilege API token, representative project fixture, account hierarchy and permission matrix, or token-rotation procedure is available in this workspace.
providerSetup.nextAction: A VWO administrator creates or rotates an Enterprise API token with the least available permission level, saves it through Relay Console, then verifies minimized current-account project listing, account hierarchy boundaries, agent assignment, token replacement, revocation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: VWO documents Enterprise-only API access, account-generated API tokens, selectable permission levels, campaign lifecycle and report capabilities, and the need to choose permissions appropriate to the use case.
The official reference documents authenticated GET /api/v2/accounts/{account_id}/projects for account and sub-account project discovery.
VWO's reference explicitly identifies the case-sensitive token request header as the VWO API authentication token and documents application/json response negotiation.
